summary: Staff pharmacist with a Doctor of Pharmacy and nine years of retail pharmacy experience in a high-volume setting, managing ancillary staff and fulfilling more than 1,500 prescriptions weekly. Experienced in prescription dispensing and compounding, drug utilization review, drug interaction assessment, and counseling physicians and patients on dosing, side effects and OTC products. Maintains controlled-substance records and inventory, and manages insurance and reimbursement issues with HMOs and other payers. Brings a background in science and electronics engineering and seeks to build clinical experience in a hospital setting.
